message.content: In one of the conversations, LiHua shared tips on balancing work and personal hobbies with Chae. Specifically, LiHua mentioned that managing work-life balance is crucial and highlighted the importance of finding a healthy equilibrium between professional responsibilities and personal pursuits. LiHua shared his own experience of balancing work and fitness, indicating that maintaining a routine that supports both aspects is key. LiHua also encouraged Chae to explore and engage in activities that align with their interests, suggesting that hobbies like music and singing can be beneficial for mental health and overall well-being. LiHua proposed sharing tips on managing work-life balance as a freelancer, emphasizing the significance of creating a sustainable schedule that allows for both career growth and personal enjoyment. LiHua further encouraged Chae to participate in social gatherings and potentially plan fun get-togethers, hinting at the value of community and social connections in achieving a balanced lifestyle.
